notes: Original cached text title/authors verified; Experiment 2a is on printed p. 237 (PDF p. 8). Original text OCR renders t-test df as 2S; value 2.86 and p < .01 are clear. Replication reference and supplied Google Drive PDF agree on Pashler, Harris, and Coburn, Elderly-Related Words Prime Slow Walking. This report has no numbered Study 2 or p. 9, so target_match is false; the reference-matched walking-time test is extracted without claiming that it resolves the conflicting locator. The supplied DOI instead identifies Cesario, Plaks, and Higgins (2006), Automatic Social Behavior as Motivated Preparation to Interact. DOI landing route was inaccessible and one alternative PDF route returned 404; no values from that different paper were merged. Requested partial eta-squared is not printed in the reference-matched report; its printed t statistic is retained without conversion. Replication N is explicitly a reported subject count, not a documented final analytic sample after exclusions.
